"v1.5.9 • Television: brand tiles for streaming services and studios on the home screen; episode and source pickers rebuilt as panels for the remote; rows scroll only when the highlighted card would leave the screen • Title pages open in one step with artwork, logo, facts and studio marks together, and nothing shifts afterwards; Read more scrolls with the text • Background choice: blurred artwork or one of three colour patterns; softer default blur with an extra strength; a smaller default interface size and a new Tiny size • Automatic subtitle choice prefers files made for web releases and the most-downloaded file, the same file the manual list puts first • Sync subtitles now listens to the dialogue on the device itself and matches it to the subtitle text, answering within a couple of minutes from anywhere in a title; runs automatically and backs off when a title cannot be matched • Find subtitles online from the player, prefilled with what is playing; a subtitle you pick is never re-timed automatically • One source added, two moved to new addresses; three anime-only sources, one with Indian audio • A source chosen by hand stays chosen; casting warns when a VPN would block it • Parental controls also hide titles with no age rating; bulk delete in My List; clearing My List clears Favourites too • Search suggestions match the width of the search box and the clear-history control is always visible • Translations completed across all languages
v1.5.8 • New television interface built for the remote: home with a featured title, browse, search with suggestions, title pages with seasons, cast and related titles, My List, parental controls and settings • Subtitles are no longer retimed automatically; Sync subtitles runs only when asked, measures two stretches of the soundtrack and only acts when both agree • Fixed subtitles drifting during a title, disappearing when switching source, doubling up, or arriving in the wrong language • Subtitle position can be adjusted; the preferred subtitle language setting is honoured • Automatic quality starts at a sensible resolution and the quality button names what is actually playing; every quality a source offers can be chosen, including 4K; HDR no longer switches itself off • One next-episode card instead of two, an Autoplay next episode setting, and an episode button in the player • Episode lists rebuilt with stills, air dates, running times and descriptions; tapping an episode plays it; watched episodes show a progress bar • Search can be narrowed to films or series and sorted by rating or date; junk entries are hidden • Parental controls with an age limit that hides titles throughout the app; age ratings read far more reliably • Fixed watch progress not syncing between devices, and a startup crash for anyone affected • Fixed loading failures on certain VPNs and networks that block the film database; the connection help screen works on more devices • Sources that stop responding are skipped sooner; sources that no longer exist were removed • Profile pictures can be zoomed and panned; the About page was rewritten; translations updated across all languages
v1.4.0 • Localized Metadata: Movie and show descriptions, taglines, and episode titles now automatically appear in Dutch when the app language is set to Nederlands • Global App Access Lock: Implemented a mandatory security screen on launch to ensure authorized access only • Security Hardening: Improved internal protection mechanisms to safeguard app integrity and user data • UI Performance Peak: Optimized image processing and increased cache capacity, resulting in perfectly fluid 120Hz scrolling through categories • Snappy Interactions: Replaced standard long-press with a custom high-speed interaction and added haptic feedback for a more premium feel • Stability Fixes: Resolved a critical Picture-in-Picture crash and refined data parsing for the new Favourites system
v1.3.9 • Favourites System: Added a new 'Favourites' tab to My List. You can now star titles from the detail page or options menu • PIP Stability Patch: Fixed a crash issue when entering Picture-in-Picture mode with subtitles active • UI Visibility: Added subtle shadows to navigation buttons to ensure visibility on bright backdrops • Subtitle Search Automation: Tapping 'Manual search' now instantly starts searching using the current title for a faster experience • Improved Stability: Fully removed experimental components and reverted to stable subtitle logic to ensure reliable and fast loading • Verified Performance: Preserved all recent stability fixes including improved browse deduplication and server connection logic • Memory Stability: Optimized image caching to prevent scrolling stutters and improve app reliability • Scraper Stability: Fixed background search engine issues to ensure reliable results • Background Audio Patch: Fixed a bug where audio would continue playing when switching between titles
v1.3.8 • Fixed a major crash occurring when skipping to the next episode in Picture-in-Picture mode • Fixed an issue where the loading overlay could obscure the Picture-in-Picture window • Added a non-intrusive notification to inform users when a new stream is being searched • Fixed casting reliability by resolving data processing issues in the connection layer • Resolved a bug where the loading screen would get stuck after a successful cast • Added intelligent internet connectivity checks with user notifications • Overhauled screen resize logic to better handle different aspect ratios (Fit, Zoom, Fill) • Corrected localization for randomized loading phrases
v1.3.7 • Fixed video seeking failures by maintaining reliable search sessions • Optimized the server priority list for faster connection times • Translated missing interface text to Dutch • Made History and My List views more compact to fit more items on screen • Added multi-select mode to My List for easier bulk management • Added 'Select All' and 'Delete All' functionality to Watch History and My List • Added swipeable navigation tabs to My List for a smoother experience • Revamped the Watch History tab into a unified, easy-to-read list • Fixed an issue where certain categories would occasionally fail to load due to API limits • Reorganized the Browse tabs for better category discoverability
v1.3.6 • Centered and fully redesigned the My List tabs as pill-shaped toggle buttons • Fixed reload animation glitch in the detail screen when returning from the player
v1.3.5 • Improved Player UI: Gestures now use beautiful vector icons instead of emojis • Fixed gesture hitbox: Gestures no longer accidentally trigger when tapping near the edge, top controls, or seekbar • Gestures now intelligently show on their respective sides of the screen rather than in the center • Search bug fixed: Long pressing a search result now correctly scales the item without dropping the press • Swapped server priority list for faster connections • Restored reliable stream fallbacks • Enabled volume and brightness gesture controls even while playback is paused
v1.3.4 • Added a dark blocking overlay to prevent interaction while searching for subtitles • Improved subtitle extraction to support more extensions and parse languages more robustly • Changed subtitle popups to use a neutral ripple effect • Subtitle background is now disabled by default for a cleaner look • Extracted embedded stream subtitles now automatically sync to the casting overlay • Fixed seekbar jumping where dragging or skipping would snap back • Unified seek tracking to prevent unpredictable jumps on rapid clicks • Corrected auto-advance logic so the next episode countdown pauses precisely when the video is paused • Patched subtitle loading to prevent the local player from unpausing while casting • Smoothed out the Detail screen animation when returning from the player • Search speed greatly improved by running parallel background API requests • Fixed the double-back-press requirement to exit the video player • Eliminated the visual flash when exiting the player • Shorter, simpler haptic vibration for long presses • Show rating and year enabled by default in settings • Fixed stuck subtitle cues when switching episodes • Fixed double-tap seek to instantly show the popup and accumulate time • Made stream failovers fully seamless by tracking exact timestamps • Re-implemented manual subtitle search with full localization • Completely rebuilt the Subtitles dialog: added a real-time search filter and improved layout • Added Subtitle Settings: preferred language and auto-select options • Improved app startup performance on mobile data
v1.3.3 • Improved update detection logic to prevent false prompts • More robust filename parsing for the in-app updater
v1.3.2 • Full animation rework: all animations now run at a fixed, consistent speed • Added a monitor to immediately re-pin the animator scale if changed by the system • Fixed the hero image double-animation glitch on refresh • Fixed hero image glitch when switching tabs • Fixed the search keyboard not appearing automatically on some devices
v1.3.1 • Updated stream source domains • Integrated new permanent server candidates • Improved content filtering to block explicit results • Fixed a playback bug where paused video would automatically resume • Added a clean styled info notice during stream searching
v1.3.0 • Added a back button on the loading screen • Reworked the long-press hint: tapping it now opens the item • The hint highlights the item with a soft glow ring • Every reset action now asks for confirmation first • Cleaner, smaller hint labels • Added a toggle to show the long-press hint once or every time • Settings: new Reset section for cleared data and fresh starts
v1.2.9 • Improved search suggestion speed • Replaced system toast with a stylish discovery overlay • Humanized the \"About\" section for a friendlier feel • Fixed long-press support in search and similar titles
v1.2.8 • Added reactive \"push down\" feedback to all interactive items • New age certification badges in detail views • Standardized system back-button behavior with smooth transitions • Robust server-switching logic that maintains stream state • Improved audio focus handling for external events • UX: Added a hint to the welcome screen about long-pressing items
v1.2.7 • Sort/filter button in all grids (Popular, Top rated, Newest, A to Z) • Update prompt: \"Don't remind me\" only mutes that specific version • My List search box hint and finished Dutch translations • Smoother category grid scrolling • Restyled dialog buttons and a cleaner drawer menu • Faster, more reliable activity transitions • Hardware-accelerated fades for the detail view
v1.2.6 • Failsafe activity transitions: replaced system transitions with manual fades • Instant tab-switching and refresh in Browse views • Robust floating scroll-down button in Settings
v1.2.5 • Bolder, cleaner app bar branding • More animations pinned to a fixed speed • Switching servers now resumes at the current time • My List updates instantly after removing a title • Hidden scraper components are now always muted • Snappier press feedback and touch reactions • Hero images no longer flicker or double-load • Pull-to-refresh now rotates in genuinely new titles • Ratings and year now show more consistently • Next-episode card repositioned to never block controls • PIP gained previous/next episode buttons
v1.2.4 • Next-episode card now counts down and auto-plays • Welcome notice shows once per launch • Detail page header rebuilt: title bar and back button never get covered • All tabs preload at launch for smooth switching • Remembers screen orientation and rotation lock • Age ratings read clearer
v1.2.1 • Switching episodes now fully reloads the player for a clean start • Previous / next episode buttons added to the cast controls • Casting keeps running with the screen locked • Subtitles work while casting with dedicated controls • Last-watched episode is remembered and restored
v1.1.9 • Renamed to ClipBox • New bottom navigation layout • Popular networks and studio rows • Star rating and year overlay on posters • Cast rebuilt on the official device picker • Season and episode last-watched remembered per show • Auto-advance to next episode with countdown • Language switching applied instantly
v1.1.8 • Initial stream source integration • DLNA casting via local proxy • Modern browse interface with hero header • Bilingual UI (English / Dutch)"

"ClipBox is a streaming app for Android, made by a team of passionate developers.
Everything lives in one place. Browse what is popular, search for something specific, or pick up exactly where you left off. Every title offers several sources, subtitles are found and timed for you in a wide range of languages, and anything you are watching can be sent to a television. An optional account keeps your list and your history in step across every device you use."

"ClipBox is an independent media front-end for Android. It does not host, store, upload, transmit or control any video, audio, subtitle or other media content. Everything played through the app is provided by third-party sources that are not affiliated with, endorsed by or controlled by ClipBox, and that may change or disappear at any time.
ClipBox claims no ownership of third-party content and does not authorise copyright infringement. You are solely responsible for ensuring that your use of the app and of any source complies with the copyright, licensing and other laws that apply where you are. Requests to remove or disable access to content should be directed to the third-party source or rights holder concerned, as ClipBox holds no content to remove.
Title and artwork metadata is provided by The Movie Database (TMDB). ClipBox is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Subtitles may come from OpenSubtitles and may be machine-translated, so their accuracy and timing are not guaranteed.
Netflix, IMDb, TMDB, OpenSubtitles, Google, Chromecast, Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV, Amazon, ExoPlayer, Media3, DLNA and all other names and trademarks are used for identification only and imply no sponsorship, endorsement or affiliation."

"1. What ClipBox Is ClipBox is a free media front-end for Android. It provides playback: video rendering, subtitle handling, casting and library management. ClipBox does not host, store, upload, transmit or control any video, audio or subtitle content. Everything you play comes from third-party sources that are not operated by, affiliated with, or endorsed by ClipBox.
2. Accepting These Terms By installing or using ClipBox you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the app. These Terms form a binding agreement between you and ClipBox.
3. Eligibility You must be at least 13 years old, or the minimum age required in your country, whichever is higher. If you are under the age of majority where you live, you need the consent of a parent or guardian.
4. Licence You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable licence to use ClipBox on your own Android devices for personal, non-commercial purposes.
5. Your Responsibility for Content You are solely responsible for what you access through the app and for making sure it is lawful where you live. Copyright law differs by country; accessing material you have no right to view may breach it. ClipBox responds to valid takedown notices under the DMCA and equivalent laws, and will disable features or integrations in response to valid legal orders. Notices go to info@clipbox.mov — but as ClipBox hosts nothing, they are usually better directed at the source or rights holder concerned.
6. Things You May Not Do Do not use ClipBox to access or distribute infringing or unlawful material; do not reverse-engineer, decompile or modify the app beyond what the law allows; do not redistribute, resell or sublicense it; do not use it commercially without written permission; and do not attack, disrupt or attempt unauthorised access to any system or account connected to the service.
7. Accounts An account is optional — the app works fully without one. If you create one, you choose a username and password; no email address is required or collected. The password is stored only as a salted hash and cannot be read by us. A recovery code is issued once at sign-up: it is the only way to recover an account, we store only a hash of it, and we cannot restore it for you if it is lost. You are responsible for keeping your credentials secure. Accounts used to abuse or attack the service may be suspended without notice.
8. What Syncs to Your Account While you are signed in, your My List, watch history, favourites, playback positions and app settings are stored on our server so they follow you between devices. When you sign out, that library is removed from the device and stays only in your account, so the next person to sign in on the same device does not inherit it. Deleting your account from the Account screen permanently deletes this data from our server.
9. Anonymous Usage Data The app reports basic, anonymous information about the installation so we can understand how it is used and which devices to support: a random identifier generated at install, device model and manufacturer, Android and app version, the language the app is set to, a two-letter country derived from our content delivery network, screen size, how often the app is opened, and what was watched and for how long.
This identifier is randomly generated. It is not an advertising identifier, not a hardware serial, and it is not linked to your account or to any information that identifies you. We do not store your IP address and we do not collect location data. Individual viewing records are deleted after 120 days.
10. Advertising The free version of ClipBox is supported by advertising. Unless your account has VIP or Founders, the app may show a short advertisement before playback and banners on some screens. Ads are served by third-party advertising partners (currently Monetag, and where used Google’s Interactive Media Ads SDK). When an ad loads, the partner may receive technical information such as your IP address, device and browser type, language and approximate location, and may use cookies or similar technologies, under its own privacy policy. We do not sell your personal data. Advertised products come from third parties; we do not endorse them. You may not generate fake ad views or clicks.
11. VIP, Founders and Payments VIP and Founders are optional, one-time purchases that remove advertising and raise the number of devices your account can use. They belong to your account, not to a device, and last for as long as ClipBox offers the service. They are not a subscription: nothing renews and there is nothing to cancel. Payments are made in cryptocurrency through our own payment server (BTCPay Server), or with an Azteco Bitcoin voucher bought from Azteco or one of its resellers. We never receive card or bank details. Prices are set in US dollars and the amount of cryptocurrency is fixed when you pay; any exchange, network or currency-conversion costs are your own. A voucher must be of a kind and value the app accepts at the time; we are not responsible for vouchers that were already used, have expired or were bought from an unauthorised seller. Cryptocurrency payments are irreversible. Because a package is activated as soon as your payment is seen, you ask for it to start straight away; where the law gives you a right of withdrawal, it ends once the package is active. Payments are not refundable except where the law requires it. An underpayment activates nothing until the rest is paid; an overpayment is not returned automatically. A payment that turns out to be invalid or fraudulent, or a package used to abuse the service, may be reversed and the package removed. Donations are voluntary, give no additional rights and are not refundable.
